# Higher-Kinded-J

> Higher-Kinded-J is a functional programming library for Java 25. It gives Java composable, typed error handling (the Effect Path API), optics for immutable records and sealed interfaces (the Focus DSL), compile-time DTO mapping that reports every bad field at once (`@GenerateMapping`), for-comprehensions, monad transformers, virtual-thread concurrency, resilience patterns, and Spring Boot integration.

Key facts:

- Java 25 is required. Parts of the library are compiled with preview features, so the build plugins set `--enable-preview`. Code using `Either`, `Validated`, the optics or the mapper needs no flag; the parallel virtual-thread stream operations (`VStreamPar`) do.
- Maven group `io.github.higher-kinded-j`. Main artefact `hkj-core`; annotation processors `hkj-processor` and `hkj-processor-plugins`; versions aligned by `hkj-bom`.
- Annotation processors write plain Java at compile time: no reflection, no runtime registry.
- Every link below is the page's Markdown. Swap `.md` for `.html` to get the rendered page.
- Each main chapter is also published whole as `llms-<chapter>.txt` (see "Chapter files"), and the entire book as `llms-full.txt`, which runs to several megabytes.

## Install

Gradle, the recommended route:

```kotlin
plugins {
    id("io.github.higher-kinded-j.hkj") version "LATEST_VERSION"
}
```

The plugin adds `hkj-core`, the annotation processors, `-parameters`, the preview flags and the compile-time Path checks. Maven has an equivalent `hkj-maven-plugin`, added with `<extensions>true</extensions>` beside the `hkj-bom` import.

- [Quickstart](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/quickstart.md): Gradle and Maven setup, why Java 25 and preview, a first Effect Path
- [Build Plugins](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/tooling/gradle_plugin.md): the Gradle `hkj { }` DSL and the Maven plugin's configuration
- [Manual Gradle and Maven Setup](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/tooling/manual_setup.md): builds that cannot use a plugin, and the processor order with Lombok
- [Where to Start](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/where_to_start.md): which tool fits the problem you have
- [Cheat Sheet](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/cheatsheet.md): every Path type, its operators, and the way back to plain Java

## Mapping DTOs at the boundary: @GenerateMapping

A generated replacement for hand-written DTO mappers, MapStruct mappers and Bean Validation at a service boundary. Declare one interface; the processor writes its Impl at compile time:

```java
@GenerateMapping
interface OrderMapping extends MappingSpec<Order, OrderDto> {
    default ValidatedPrism<String, UUID> id() { return StandardCodecs.uuid(); }  // a leaf: one field's conversion
}

OrderDto dto = OrderMappingImpl.INSTANCE.build(order);                          // total: cannot fail
Validated<NonEmptyList<FieldError>, Order> result = OrderMappingImpl.INSTANCE.parse(dto);
```

- `parse` reports every bad field at once, each located by a path such as `customer.email` or `lines.1.price`, and a missing field is a located `must not be null`, not an exception.
- A conversion is declared per field and never inferred from the types. `StandardCodecs` covers identifiers, dates, enums, numbers and money, each accepting exactly the spelling it renders.
- Returned from a Spring Boot controller, a failed `parse` becomes one 422 Unprocessable Content response listing every field error (the status is configurable).
- Wire shapes: records, getter/setter and builder beans (Lombok and openapi-generator models included), read-only and write-only beans, protobuf-java messages, sealed hierarchies, and generic records such as `Page<T>`.
- Also: `@MapField` (renames), `@OptionalBridge` (a `null` that means absent), `@MapKey`, `@Flatten`, `@Unmapped`, `@ReadOnly`, `UpdateSpec` (sparse PATCH, `JsonNullable` included), `@GenerateMerge` (one target from several sources), `@GenerateErrorEnvelope` (a typed error context), and `MappingLaws` (law-check a mapping in your own tests).

Pages:

- [Mapping at the Boundary](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/mapping/ch_intro.md): why a generated mapper, what it will and will not generate, and how to read the chapter
- [Quickstart: Your First 422](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/mapping/quickstart.md): from a blank project to a Spring endpoint that answers with every bad field at once
- [Mapper at a Glance](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/mapping/at_a_glance.md): what it generates, what it costs, which wire shapes map, and the decisions to know before adopting
- [Coming from MapStruct and Bean Validation](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/mapping/from_mapstruct.md): MapStruct and `@Valid` vocabulary translated, migrating one pair, and when to keep MapStruct
- [Record Mapping Basics](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/mapping/basics.md): `MappingSpec`, `build` and `parse`, reading the errors, converting a field, `@MapField` renames, derived fields
- [Standard Codecs and Shared Vocabulary](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/mapping/codecs.md): `StandardCodecs`, your own canonical formats, and conversions shared across specs through mix-in interfaces

- [Capstone: An Estate in Three Modules](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/mapping/estate.md): a shared vocabulary, a partner's client jar with Lombok beans, and a PATCH

- [Compiler Messages](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/mapping/compiler_errors.md): look up a `@GenerateMapping` compile error and its fix
- [The 422 leg](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/spring/spring_boot_integration.md#the-422-leg): how Spring Boot renders a failed `parse`, and how to change the status
- [Accumulating Assembly](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/monads/validated_assembly.md): `fields()`, `accumulate()` and `@GenerateAssembly` build a record from separately validated parts, collecting every error

## Effect Path API

A railway model: success travels one track and failure another, and `map`, `via`, `recover` and `focus` work the same on every Path type.

- `MaybePath<A>`: absence is normal
- `EitherPath<E, A>`: typed errors
- `TryPath<A>`: code that throws
- `ValidationPath<E, A>`: accumulate every error, not just the first
- `EitherOrBothPath<E, A>`: success that carries warnings
- `IOPath<A>`: deferred side effects
- `VTaskPath<A>`: virtual-thread tasks; `VResultPath<E, A>` adds a typed error
- `VStreamPath<A>`: streams on virtual threads
- Also `CompletableFuturePath`, `OptionalPath`, `IdPath`, `LazyPath`, `ListPath`, `StreamPath`, `NonDetPath`, `ReaderPath`, `WriterPath`, `WithStatePath`, `TrampolinePath`, `FreePath`, `FreeApPath` and `GenericPath`

```java
userService.findById(userId)           // EitherPath<Error, User>
    .focus(UserFocus.address())        // EitherPath<Error, Address>
    .focus(AddressFocus.postcode())    // EitherPath<Error, String>
    .via(code -> validatePostcode(code));
```

- [Effect Path API](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/ch_intro.md): the chapter and its reading order
- [Effect Path Quickstart](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/quickstart.md): `MaybePath`, `EitherPath` and `ForPath` in three short examples
- [Core Paths Overview](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/effect_path_overview.md): the problem Path types solve, and the railway model
- [Migration Cookbook](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/migration_cookbook.md): `try/catch`, nullable lookups, `CompletableFuture` and validation, translated recipe by recipe
- [Path Types Overview](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/path_types.md): choosing a Path type
- [ValidationPath](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/path_validation.md): accumulating every error
- [EitherOrBothPath](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/path_either_or_both.md): success with warnings
- [Composition Patterns](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/composition.md): sequential, independent and parallel composition
- [ForPath Comprehension](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/forpath_comprehension.md): for-comprehensions that return Path types
- [Focus-Effect Integration](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/focus_integration.md): moving between optics paths and Effect Paths
- [Effect Contexts](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/effect_contexts.md): transformer power without transformer syntax
- [Effect Handlers](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/effect_handlers_intro.md): `@EffectAlgebra`, programs as values, several interpreters
- [Resilience Patterns](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/resilience/ch_intro.md): retry, circuit breaker, bulkhead and saga on Paths and `VTask`
- [Common Compiler Errors](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/effect/compiler_errors.md): Path compile errors and their fixes

## Optics and the Focus DSL

Type-safe reads and updates of immutable data, generated by annotation processors for records and sealed interfaces.

- Optics: `Lens`, `Prism`, `Iso`, `Affine`, `Traversal`, `Fold`, `Getter`, `Setter`, `At`/`Ixed`, `Each`, and indexed variants
- Focus DSL: `FocusPath<S, A>` (exactly one), `AffinePath<S, A>` (zero or one), `TraversalPath<S, A>` (zero or more), with containers widened by cardinality under `@GenerateFocus(widenCollections = true)`
- Annotations: `@GenerateLenses`, `@GeneratePrisms`, `@GenerateFocus`, `@GenerateTraversals`, `@GenerateIsos`, and `@ImportOptics` for types you cannot edit
- `ValidatedPrism`: parse-don't-validate as an optic, the building block of the mapper
- `Edits`: several edits as one operation, and sparse REST PATCH

- [Optics](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/ch_intro.md): the chapter and its reading order
- [Optics Quickstart](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/quickstart.md): a deep nested update in one line
- [Annotations at a Glance](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/annotations_at_a_glance.md): which annotation generates which optic
- [What Are Optics?](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/optics_intro.md): the concepts
- [Lenses](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/lenses.md): nested record updates
- [Prisms](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/prisms.md): sealed interface variants
- [Validated Prisms](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/validated_prism.md): an accumulating parse and a total build
- [Traversals](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/traversals.md): every element of a collection
- [Focus DSL](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/focus_dsl.md): path-based navigation with `@GenerateFocus`
- [Custom Containers and Code Generation](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/focus_containers.md): container widening and generator plugins
- [Optics for External Types](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/importing_optics.md): `@ImportOptics` for JDK and third-party types
- [Multi-Edit and Sparse Updates](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/multi_edit.md): `Edits.combine` and `Edits.accumulate`
- [Common Compiler Errors](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/optics/compiler_errors.md): optics processor messages and their fixes

## Comprehensions, transformers and foundations

- [For Comprehension](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/functional/for_comprehension.md): `For`, flat sequential steps over any monad
- [ForState Comprehension](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/functional/forstate_comprehension.md): named fields instead of tuple positions
- [Monad Transformers & MTL](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/transformers/ch_intro.md): `EitherT`, `MaybeT`, `OptionalT`, `ReaderT`, `StateT`, `WriterT`, and the `MonadReader`, `MonadState` and `MonadWriter` capabilities
- [Path or Transformer?](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/transformers/when_to_drop_to_transformers.md): when the Path API is no longer enough
- [Foundations](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/hkts/foundations_intro.md): the `Kind<F, A>` encoding, type classes, and the core types
- [Type Classes](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/functional/ch_intro.md): `Functor`, `Applicative`, `Monad`, `MonadError`, `Traverse`, `Selective` and more
- [Core Types](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/monads/ch_intro.md): `Either`, `Maybe`, `Try`, `Validated`, `EitherOrBoth`, `IO`, `VTask`, `VStream`, `Free` and more
- [VTask](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/monads/vtask_monad.md): virtual-thread tasks, with [structured concurrency](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/monads/vtask_scope.md) and [resource management](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/monads/vtask_resource.md)

## Spring Boot

`hkj-spring-boot-starter` lets a controller return `Either`, `Validated` and the Path types directly, maps typed errors to HTTP statuses, renders field errors as a 422, and serialises the library's types with Jackson.

- [Spring Integration](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/spring/ch_intro.md): the chapter
- [Spring Boot Integration](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/spring/spring_boot_integration.md): controller return types, error status mapping, configuration properties, testing
- [Declarative HTTP Clients](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/spring/declarative_http_clients.md): `@HkjHttpClient`, a client whose methods return Effect Paths and decode typed errors
- [Migrating to Functional Errors](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/spring/migrating_to_functional_errors.md): from exceptions, one endpoint at a time
- [EffectBoundary Integration](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/spring/effect_boundary_integration.md): effect handler programs at a Spring boundary

## Tooling, testing and AI assistants

- [Compile-Time Checks](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/tooling/compile_checks.md): `hkj-checker`, a javac plugin that catches Path type mismatches
- [Migration Recipes](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/tooling/openrewrite.md): `hkj-openrewrite` recipes for upgrading
- [Testing With hkj-test](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/tooling/test_assertions.md): AssertJ assertions for every type (`assertThatEither`, `assertThatValidated` and more), optic and mapping laws, `SteppableClock`
- [Claude Code Skills](https://higher-kinded-j.github.io/latest/tooling/claude_code_skills.md): agent skills for the library, including `hkj-mapping`, installed with `./gradlew hkjInstallSkills` or `mvn hkj:install-skills`
